title: Le parole interrogative
rule: Who, what, which, where, when, why, how, whose, e le combinazioni di how (how much, how many, how long, how often, how old, how far). Ordine: parola interrogativa + ausiliare (do / does / did / be / can / will) + soggetto + verbo. Quando who o what è il soggetto, niente ausiliare: Who called? What happened? Le preposizioni restano alla fine: Who did you talk to? Where are you from?

head: Parola
Italiano
Esempio
rows: Who is she? Who did you call? Who called?
What is it? What do you do? What time is it? What colour?
Which account? Which one? Which bus goes downtown?
Where are you from? Where did you go?
When does it open? When were you born?
Why are you late? Why didn't you call?
How are you? How do you spell it? How was it?
Whose phone is this? Whose turn is it?
How much is it? How much time do we have?
How many people? How many times?
How long did you wait? How long is the bridge?
How often do you call home?
How old are you? How old is the house?
How far is the bank? — Ten minutes on foot.

items.t: Who did you talk to? — Amrit. Who talked to you? — Amrit.
items.n: Con chi hai parlato? — Con Amrit. Chi ti ha parlato? — Amrit.
items.note: who oggetto con did; who soggetto senza

items.t: What's your name? What do you do? What time does the bank close?
items.n: Come ti chiami? Che lavoro fai? A che ora chiude la banca?
items.note: what's your name, non how is your name

items.t: Which one do you want, the red or the blue? — The blue one.
items.n: Quale vuoi, il rosso o il blu? — Il blu.

items.t: Where are you from? Who is it for? What are you looking for?
items.n: Di dove sei? Per chi è? Cosa cerchi?

items.t: Why didn't you call? — Because I didn't have a number yet.
items.n: Perché non hai chiamato? — Perché non avevo ancora un numero.

items.t: How often do you check your balance? — Every day. How far is the branch? — Two stops.
items.n: Quanto spesso controlli il saldo? — Ogni giorno. Quanto è lontana la filiale? — Due fermate.

blocks.title: Come, perché, quale
blocks.text: Tre trappole italiane. [[Come ti chiami?]] è [[What's your name?]], non how. [[Perché]] è [[why]] nella domanda e [[because]] nella risposta. [[Quale]] è [[what]] se la scelta è aperta ([[What colour do you like?]]) e [[which]] se è fra poche cose davanti a te ([[Which colour, red or blue?]]).

items.wrong: Where you live? What she does?
items.right: Where do you live? What does she do?

items.wrong: Who did call? What did happen?
How is your name? How do you call this?
items.right: What's your name? What do you call this?

items.wrong: From where are you? To who did you talk?
items.right: Where are you from? Who did you talk to?

items.wrong: How much people? How many money?
items.right: How many people? How much money?

items.q: ___ do you live? — On Nairn Avenue. ___ long have you been here? — Two weeks. ___ did you come? — Because of the bakery.
items.n: Dove abiti? — Su Nairn Avenue. Da quanto sei qui? — Due settimane. Perché sei venuta? — Per la pasticceria.

items.why: Who è il soggetto: niente did. Who did he call? = chi ha chiamato lui?

items.answer: What time does the bank close on Fridays?
items.n: A che ora chiude la banca il venerdì?
